errors.evidence: The line falls below the zero line in 2014, not in 2016. In 2016, the value reaches its minimum for the depicted period.
The value for 2016 is approximately -0.5%, which is the lowest point on the graph. The reported value of -0.20% is significantly incorrect.
The value for the year 2018 is approximately 2.5%, not 2.6% as stated in the description.
